description:
Create a voice agent

Creates a voice agent and provisions it in the voice engine in the same request, so the agent is ready to take calls as soon as the call succeeds. Only `name` and `language` are required; every other field falls back to a platform default, and `language` is normalised to a two-letter code, so a value like "german" is stored as `de`. The response is a short acknowledgement rather than the full agent, so read the agent back if you need the stored configuration. The new agent is created with status `active` and is owned by the account behind the key, or by the reseller for a reseller key.

body.description: The agent configuration. `systemToolsConfig` switches on the built-in call-control tools, and `transferNumbers` lists the numbers the agent may hand a call over to.

asrKeywords.description: Keywords for improved ASR recognition (product names, brand names, etc.).

backgroundVoiceDetection.description: If true, the agent detects and ignores background noise/voices.

enableBackchannel.description: Enables realistic listening sounds like "mhm", "yeah", "I see" during user speech.

enableFillers.description: Allows the agent to use natural filler words like "well", "actually" to sound more human.

enableInterruptions.description: If true, the agent will stop speaking immediately when the user starts talking.

firstMessage.description: The very first sentence the agent speaks when a call/chat begins. Supports SSML-like cues.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., "en", "de"). This determines the base model and pronunciation rules.

llmModel.description: The advanced LLM "brain" powering the agent. Options: EchoCall-Voice, EchoCall-Smart.

maxTokens.description: Upper limit on the number of tokens the agent can generate per response.

name.description: The unique identifier name for your voice agent. Shown in the EchoCall dashboard.

retentionDays.description: Number of days to keep conversation logs. Defaults to 30. Set to -1 for permanent storage.

saveCallAudio.description: Whether to record and store the full audio of the conversation for later review.

speed.description: Speaking speed multiplier (0.7-1.2). 0.9 = slower/clearer, 1.0 = normal, 1.1 = faster.

supportedLanguages.description: All supported languages as ISO-639-1 codes. First element = primary language. E.g. ["de", "en", "fr"].

systemPrompt.description: Instructions that define the agent's personality, knowledge, and behavior. Use clear, concise commands.

systemToolsConfig.description: System tool toggles (endCall, voicemailDetection, languageDetection, playKeypadTouchTone, skipTurn).

temperature.description: Controls randomness. 0 is deterministic/focused, 100 is highly creative/varied.

transferNumbers.description: Phone numbers the agent can transfer calls to.

ttsModel.description: Text-to-speech model. Leave unset for automatic selection based on `language`. `echocall-flash`: fast, multilingual (recommended default). `echocall-flash-lite`: fastest, English only. `echocall-ultra`: most expressive/natural, supports emotional audio tags, widest language coverage. `echocall-multilingual`: balanced multilingual quality. Each model supports a different set of languages for `language`/`supportedLanguages` - pick a model that covers your target language(s), otherwise the request may fail.

turnEagerness.description: How quickly the agent responds: patient (waits longer), normal, eager (responds fast).

voiceId.description: The unique ID of the EchoCall voice to be used for speech synthesis.

zeroPiiRetention.description: Privacy mode. If enabled, PII data is stripped and logs are not permanently stored.
